title: Low-volatility stocks in NIFTY 100 or 200, long only
hypothesis: The point-in-time NIFTY 100 or 200 stocks with the lowest 6- or 12-month daily volatility have a higher Sharpe ratio and a smaller drawdown than the equal-weighted universe, after charges.

mechanism.text: Lottery preference and leverage-constrained, benchmark-bound managers overpay for risky stocks.

evidence.source: Frazzini and Pedersen, Journal of Financial Economics 111(1)
evidence.finding: Low-beta assets earn more per unit of risk.

evidence.source: Ang, Hodrick, Xing and Zhang, Journal of Finance 61(1)
evidence.finding: High idiosyncratic volatility stocks earn low returns.
Low volatility ahead of NIFTY 200 in about 96% of rolling windows since 2005, about 5% a year of alpha, mostly back-tested.

evidence.source: Indian studies on NSE data, 2010-2020 (NMIMS Management Review 2018 and others)
evidence.finding: The low-risk anomaly holds at 5-10 year horizons, weak at 6 months to 3 years.

universe.name: nifty100-or-200-pit
universe.rule: Members on each rebalance date; at least the volatility window of history.

turnover.basis: semi-annual: about 25% turnover a rebalance x 0.33% CNC round trip

prior_trials.basis: No cross-sectional rule has been run in this repo.

holdout_rule.pass_if: Holdout Sharpe ratio above the universe's and the holdout drawdown at most 0.9 times the universe's.

kill_criteria: Holdout Sharpe at or below the equal-weighted universe's.
Holdout drawdown more than 0.9 times the universe's.
Benjamini-Hochberg across the programme at q = 0.10 does not keep it.

prior.reason: Robust globally and in India, slow to decay; judged on risk-adjusted return, which a 3.8-year holdout measures noisily.

feasibility.reason: Same blockers as eh-01: #71 point-in-time membership and history, #72 portfolios.

contamination: Discovery's 527 daily rule trials and the equity library ran on about 2.3 years of daily bars (2024 to 2026) of NIFTY 50 stocks: single-stock timing rules, not this cross-sectional rule. No cross-sectional portfolio has been run on any part of this span in this repo.
